text: 我很生气，因为我我打开短视频平台刷了好久，推荐的视频一个比一个无聊，我根本看不进去。
en: I am very angry, because when I opened short-video platforms and scrolled for a long time, the recommended videos were each more boring than the last, and I simply could not get into them.

text: 这是怎么了？
en: What is going on?

text: 你的大数据呢？
en: Where is your big data?

text: 算法呢？
en: Where is the algorithm?

text: 个性化推送呢？
en: Where is personalised recommendation?

text: 对我爱好的精准把控呢？
en: Where is the precise grasp of my preferences?

text: 拿了我这么多数据，就这？
en: You took so much of my data, and this is it?

text: 你得支棱起来呀。
en: You need to shape up.

text: 于是我开始一个个手动给那些不喜欢的视频打标记，点不感兴趣，寻找稍微有意思一点的视频，给它们转发点赞评论。
en: So I started manually marking the videos I did not like one by one, tapping 'not interested', looking for slightly more interesting videos, and forwarding, liking and commenting on them.

text: 累了一上午，终于好看点了。
en: After a tiring morning, they finally looked a bit better.

text: 网上有人说了这个现象，
en: Someone online described this phenomenon:

text: “我点赞转发评论，不是因为我想点赞转发评论，是因为我怕大数据忘了我”。
en: 'I like, forward and comment not because I want to like, forward and comment, but because I am afraid big data will forget me'.

text: 这个说法其实挺有趣的。
en: This statement is actually quite interesting.

text: 大数据搜集所有人的喜好，并不执着于某一个人。
en: Big data collects everyone's preferences and is not fixated on any one person.

text: 你不表达自己的倾向，它就按照别人的喜好去推送了。
en: If you do not express your tendencies, it pushes according to other people's preferences.

text: 会哭的孩子才有奶喝，会养号的用户才有奶头乐。
en: The child who cries gets milk; the user who nurtures their account gets pacifying entertainment.

text: 同样是奶头乐，也分奥力给味的和草莓味的，既然躲不掉，不如让它变成自己喜欢的口味。
en: Pacifying entertainment also comes in flavours — Aoli-gei flavour and strawberry flavour. Since you cannot escape it, you might as well make it a flavour you like.

text: 我的短视频APP打开来，首页都是各种烤肉火锅小龙虾，牛老师打开来，首页都是黑丝小哥哥，半裸小哥哥。
en: When I open my short-video app, the homepage is all barbecue, hotpot and crayfish; when Teacher Niu opens his, the homepage is all guys in black stockings and half-naked guys.

text: 同样的APP，在我们的手里实际上已经变成了完全不同的两种生物，我们的一部分已经融进了平台的算法里，就像基因编码一样记录了我们的灵魂。
en: The same app, in our hands, has actually become two completely different creatures. Part of us has melted into the platform's algorithm, recording our souls like genetic code.

text: 我的那个APP只有给我才最有吸引力，给别人会变成什么东西。
en: My app is only most attractive to me; what would it become for someone else?

text: 算法只推荐你喜欢的内容，这是一种诡异的忠诚，魔幻的契约。
en: The algorithm only recommending content you like is a strange kind of loyalty, a magical contract.

text: 有点坏，又有点好。
en: A bit bad, and a bit good.

text: 很魔幻。
en: Very magical.

text: 如果有一天，一切都归于混沌，牛老师的陌生人社交APP不推送他最爱的富老头了，富老头都推给我了，对我来说是一种负担，对牛老师来说更是一种背叛。
en: If one day everything returns to chaos, and Teacher Niu's stranger-social app no longer pushes his beloved rich old men, but pushes the rich old men to me instead, that would be a burden for me, and even more a betrayal for Teacher Niu.

text: 所以我仔细筛选，捏紧手里的硬币，吝惜每一个点赞。
en: So I screen carefully, clutching the coins in my hand, sparing every like.

text: 那些不够喜欢的内容，我绝不投币，不是因为我喜欢白嫖，只是不想让大数据误会我和它们的关系。
en: Content I do not like enough, I absolutely will not tip — not because I like getting things for free, but because I do not want big data to misunderstand my relationship with them.

text: 如果你把内容平台的算法理解成一个监视者，搜集你的喜好是为了暗搓搓做坏事，那当然会毛骨悚然。
en: If you understand a content platform's algorithm as a watcher, collecting your preferences to secretly do bad things, then of course it feels creepy.

text: 但我们为什么不能反过来调教大数据呢？
en: But why can't we turn around and train big data instead?

text: 只要你明白了算法的推送原理，那它可以被你玩儿成一个24小时不睡觉搜集你喜好的舔狗。
en: As long as you understand the algorithm's recommendation principle, it can be played by you as a simp that never sleeps, collecting your preferences around the clock.

text: 你想看什么，它就给你推什么，如果你给的是正反馈，就继续推，加大力度，如果是负反馈，就减少推送，改为其他随机内容。
en: Whatever you want to watch, it pushes to you; if you give positive feedback, it keeps pushing, with greater force; if negative feedback, it reduces the pushing and switches to other random content.

text: 不惜代价和运算量，不惜成本和时间，一点点测试出你的喜好，根据变化实时调整策略，只为了能够让你多看一眼，能够再见你一面。
en: Sparing no cost and computing power, sparing no cost and time, testing out your preferences bit by bit, adjusting its strategy in real time according to changes, just so you will look one more time, just so it can see you again.

text: 这已经不是舔狗精神所能概况的了，舔狗科学。
en: This is beyond what simp spirit can summarise — simp science.

text: 至于这些信息会不会变成你的弱点，拿来投放广告，只要你打死不掏钱，大数据又能拿你怎么样？
en: As for whether this information will become your weakness and be used to serve ads, as long as you refuse to pay a cent, what can big data do to you?

text: 穷才是最没有破绽的自保方法，我没什么可失去的，那我就是无敌的。
en: Being poor is the most flawless method of self-protection: I have nothing to lose, so I am invincible.

text: 当然，别开通网贷功能。
en: Of course, do not activate the online loan function.

text: 调教信息茧房容易，改变自己的内心很难。
en: Training the information cocoon is easy; changing your own heart is hard.

text: 牛老师有一段时间为了提升自己，开始故意点进那些自己不喜欢的短视频，给根本看不进去的科普内容点赞，给黑丝小哥哥和扭腰跳舞视频点不感兴趣，试图欺骗大数据。
en: For a time, Teacher Niu, in order to improve himself, deliberately clicked into short videos he did not like, liked science content he could not get into at all, and tapped 'not interested' on guys in black stockings and waist-twisting dance videos, trying to deceive big data.

text: 他成功了，几个月后他的首页全是金融一百年，剑桥中国史，东汉生死观。
en: He succeeded: a few months later his homepage was all 'One Hundred Years of Finance', Cambridge History of China, and Views on Life and Death in the Eastern Han.

text: 但他也失败了，因为他骗得了大数据，骗不了自己。
en: But he also failed, because he could deceive big data but not himself.

text: 他哭着对我说，自己还是喜欢小哥哥。
en: Crying, he told me he still likes young guys.

text: 不喜欢就是不喜欢，与大数据无关。
en: Not liking something is not liking it, and it has nothing to do with big data.

text: 这时候，一个魔幻的事情就发生了。
en: At this point, a magical thing happened.

text: 我们都知道自己被算法绑架了，但同时我们也被算法驯化了。
en: We all know we have been hijacked by algorithms, but at the same time we have also been tamed by algorithms.

text: 我的生活不会因为离开这个基地变得更好，也不会因为被牢笼困住变得更差。
en: My life will not get better because I leave this base, nor will it get worse because I am trapped in this cage.

text: 甚至可以这样想，在现实中买房子很难，但是每个人都可以在虚拟世界里建设自己的信息茧房。
en: You could even think of it this way: in reality it is hard to buy a house, but everyone can build their own information cocoon in the virtual world.

text: 无论贫穷富有，贤与不肖，都平等地拥有装修信息茧房的能力，算法公平地对待每一个人。
en: Whether poor or rich, worthy or unworthy, all equally have the ability to decorate their information cocoon, and the algorithm treats everyone fairly.

text: 我的每一个点赞关注转发，都是在挑选自己喜欢的地砖和三合板，建造出合乎心意的房子。
en: Every like, follow and forward of mine is choosing my favourite floor tiles and plywood, building a house to my liking.

text: 如果是老色皮，那么这个房子就是KTV包间的样子。
en: If you are an old lecher, then this house looks like a KTV private room.

text: 如果热爱数学，在漫长的时间里，只给微偏分方程和几何分析点赞，那你的信息茧房会变成菲尔兹风格的，砖石是不定义的原词和公理，支柱是几何和代数，地板砖是解析几何、数论和微积分，装饰物是数学分析，天花板是拓扑学，是群论，是纯粹数学。
en: If you love mathematics, and over a long time only like partial differential equations and geometric analysis, then your information cocoon will become Fields-style: its bricks are undefined primitive terms and axioms, its pillars are geometry and algebra, its floor tiles are analytic geometry, number theory and calculus, its decorations are mathematical analysis, and its ceiling is topology, group theory, and pure mathematics.

text: 这样的信息茧房有什么不好？
en: What is wrong with such an information cocoon?

text: 谁能说没有营养？
en: Who can say it has no nutritional value?

text: 只不过大多数人并不喜欢，并不愿意住进去。
en: It is just that most people do not like it and are unwilling to live in it.

text: 就好像读书的时候老师天天说要你好好学习，大家都知道老师说得对，但依然不喜欢。
en: It is like when teachers told you every day in school to study hard: everyone knew the teacher was right, but still did not like it.

text: 不过我又想到了一个很有趣的东西，现在智能手机也不贵，我完全可以买两个手机，用两个账号。
en: But then I thought of something very interesting: smartphones are not expensive now, and I could simply buy two phones and use two accounts.

text: 一个账号都是学习的内容，有益的内容，另一个账号全都是各种人性的低级欲望，五毒俱全。
en: One account is all study content and beneficial content; the other account is all kinds of base human desires, complete with all five poisons.

text: 就好像B站有个梗，叫号已经养好了，首页可以全是骚东西，也可以全是各种科学的东西。
en: It is like a Bilibili meme: once the account has been nurtured, the homepage can be all racy stuff, or all kinds of scientific stuff.

text: 我想自我满足的时候就看第二个手机，我心怀内疚想痛改前非的时候就看第一个手机，在两个不同的信息茧房之间反复横跳。
en: When I want to satisfy myself, I watch the second phone; when I feel guilty and want to mend my ways, I watch the first phone, jumping back and forth between two different information cocoons.

text: 我们逃不出信息茧房，但我们可以在不同的信息茧房之间串门。
en: We cannot escape the information cocoon, but we can visit between different information cocoons.

text: 这个时候，到底是大数据绑架了我，还是我绑架了大数据？
en: At this point, is it big data hijacking me, or me hijacking big data?

text: 到底是算法控制了我，还是我玩弄了算法？
en: Is it the algorithm controlling me, or me playing with the algorithm?

text: 是斯德哥尔摩，还是PTSD？
en: Is it Stockholm, or PTSD?

text: 说实话，我也不知道。
en: To be honest, I do not know either.

text: 这可真是，大数据年代的伦理学啊。
en: This is truly the ethics of the big data era.

text: 今晚就做一个实验，以知乎为例，
en: Tonight, do an experiment, taking Zhihu as an example:

text: 新建一个账号，接下来的一周，每天给它分配一小时，
en: Create a new account, and over the next week, allocate one hour to it each day.

text: 要点在于——只要发现新号推荐的帖子在大号上已经看过，立刻点不喜欢，原因选择内容低质，
en: The key point is — whenever you find that a post recommended by the new account has already been seen on the main account, immediately tap 'dislike' and select 'low-quality content' as the reason.

text: 如此一周，新号的算法训练便初步完成，你会发现一个完全不同的世界。
en: After a week like this, the new account's algorithm training will be preliminarily complete, and you will discover a completely different world.

text: 其他诸如抖音、快手、小红书之类的APP，也是类似道理。
en: Other apps like Douyin, Kuaishou and Xiaohongshu follow similar principles.

text: 如果有兴趣，可以拿两台手机，同时打开APP，把大号和新号推荐的内容进行对比，
en: If you are interested, you can take two phones, open the app on both, and compare what the main account and the new account recommend.

text: 你会产生一种神奇的感觉：这居然都是我爱逛的虚拟空间？
en: You will have a magical feeling: these are all the virtual spaces I love to visit?

text: 这个实验可以使普通人直观感受算法推荐时代的神奇，
en: This experiment allows ordinary people to intuitively feel the magic of the algorithm recommendation era.

text: 世界是一面棱镜，在不同人眼中呈现完全不同的样子，
en: The world is a prism, presenting a completely different appearance in different people's eyes.

text: 同样一款APP，在不同人的手上，每天流淌着完全不同的讯息，
en: The same app, in different people's hands, flows with completely different messages every day.

text: 都是抖音，有人听芯片科普，有人听古典音乐，有人看搞笑段子，有人刷擦边视频，
en: All on Douyin: some listen to chip science, some listen to classical music, some watch funny jokes, some scroll borderline videos.

text: 不要说你不知道领导同事的手机算法会推荐什么内容，就连枕边的伴侣，也有不为你所知的一面，在你看不见的地方，偷偷刷某些你难以想象TA会感兴趣的视频，
en: Not to mention that you do not know what content your boss's and colleagues' phone algorithms will recommend — even your partner beside your pillow has a side unknown to you, secretly scrolling videos in places you cannot see that you would hardly imagine they are interested in.

text: 重新部落化，这是移动互联网时代的大趋势，我们无可躲避。
en: Re-tribalisation is the major trend of the mobile internet era, and we cannot avoid it.

text: 但如果你想成为头脑开放之人，如果你不想总是听到一种声音，以下是几条建议，
en: But if you want to become an open-minded person, if you do not always want to hear only one voice, here are a few suggestions.

text: 1、刻意训练围绕自己的信息流，包括文章、短讯、短视频，
en: 1. Deliberately train the information flow around you, including articles, short messages and short videos.

text: 在这个时代，被算法推荐内容不可避免，那就要建立训练算法的意识，
en: In this era, being recommended content by algorithms is unavoidable, so you must build awareness of training algorithms.

text: 对具备启发性的内容，释放点赞收藏喜欢标注等正反馈，对试图廉价调动情绪的讯息（名人新闻、明星八卦），果断点击不喜欢之类的负反馈。
en: For content that is enlightening, release positive feedback such as likes, favourites and 'like' tags; for messages that try to cheaply stir emotions (celebrity news, star gossip), decisively click 'dislike' and other negative feedback.

text: 值得一提的是使自己感到不快、但具备一定思考价值的信息，建议不要轻易拒绝这类信息，
en: It is worth mentioning that for information that makes you uncomfortable but has some thinking value, it is recommended not to reject it lightly,

text: 因为使你不快的观点，往往是让你成长的契机，
en: Because views that make you uncomfortable are often the opportunity for your growth,

text: 检验一流智力的标准，是头脑中能同时持有两种相反的观点，仍能正常运作。
en: The test of a first-rate intelligence is the ability to hold two opposed ideas in the mind at the same time, and still retain the ability to function.

text: 移动互联网时代，每天有无数信息扑面而来，试图吸引我们的注意力，你选择接收哪些信息，决定未来的生活前景。
en: In the mobile internet era, countless pieces of information come at you every day, trying to attract your attention; which information you choose to receive determines your future life prospects.

text: 把自己想象成君主，每天在现实和网络中映入眼帘的巨量信息，都是呈递给自己的奏折，
en: Imagine yourself as a monarch: the huge amount of information that comes into view every day in reality and online is all memorials presented to you.

text: 平庸之辈不能识别高价值信息，在那些写满垃圾信息的奏折上，徒耗心力，
en: Mediocre people cannot identify high-value information, and waste their energy on memorials filled with garbage information.

text: 成功人士会有意识控制自己接收信息的频带，自动过滤那些垃圾信息，将有限的精力用于批阅高价值奏折，
en: Successful people consciously control the frequency band of information they receive, automatically filtering out garbage information, and using their limited energy to review high-value memorials.

text: 每天在高价值奏折上多花2小时，坚持一年，就会产生巨大差距。
en: Spending 2 more hours a day on high-value memorials, persisting for a year, will produce a huge gap.

text: 2、刻意回归“人找信息”的互联网逻辑，
en: 2. Deliberately return to the 'people seek information' logic of the internet.

text: 最近十余年，字节系算法带来互联网底层逻辑之变更，从原先的人找信息（百度一下），到如今的信息找人（算法推荐内容），
en: In the past decade or so, ByteDance-style algorithms have changed the underlying logic of the internet, from the original 'people seek information' (Baidu it) to today's 'information seeks people' (algorithm-recommended content).

text: 在无数次滑动中，多数人陷入同质信息的茧房，不知不觉被规训，丧失主动寻找信息的能力。
en: In countless scrolls, most people fall into homogeneous information cocoons, unconsciously disciplined, losing the ability to actively seek information.

text: 解决方案是什么？
en: What is the solution?

text: 一方面是如上一条所说，刻意训练算法，拒绝被推荐垃圾信息；另一方面则是要适当回归“人找信息”的互联网逻辑，
en: On one hand, as the previous item says, deliberately train algorithms and refuse to be recommended garbage information; on the other hand, appropriately return to the 'people seek information' logic of the internet.

text: 具体包括两条，
en: Specifically, this includes two points:

text: 1）主动检索信息，建立周期性检索高质量信息的习惯，
en: 1) Actively retrieve information, and establish the habit of periodically retrieving high-quality information.

text: 2）建立付费获取信息的意识，无论是得到的各种专栏，还是知识星球的私域讯息，抑或付费咨询行业大佬，都可以。
en: 2) Establish awareness of paying for information, whether it is various columns on Dedao, private-domain messages on Zhishi Xingqiu, or paid consultations with industry leaders — all are fine.

text: 3、培养使用学术资源的习惯，
en: 3. Cultivate the habit of using academic resources.

text: 首先要熟悉本领域主要数据库，比如理科生常用的是Web of Science和IEEE，
en: First, familiarise yourself with the main databases in your field; for example, science students commonly use Web of Science and IEEE.

text: 多数领域，学术资料仍然是最具参考价值的优质信息，
en: In most fields, academic materials remain the most valuable high-quality information.

text: 东土大唐的信息是分层的，越往上，信息广度、信息深度以及信息真实度越强大，
en: Information in the Eastern Land of Great Tang is layered: the higher up you go, the greater the breadth, depth and authenticity of information.

text: 而对信息的宽容度与信息的传播效率成反比，即，越晦涩难懂的知识or信息，监管越松，尺度越大，越通俗易懂的知识or信息，监管越严，尺度越小。
en: And tolerance for information is inversely proportional to the efficiency of information dissemination: that is, the more obscure and difficult the knowledge or information, the looser the regulation and the larger the latitude; the more popular and easy-to-understand the knowledge or information, the stricter the regulation and the smaller the latitude.

text: 从信息宽容度的角度看，学术著作论文＞通俗读物＞音频＞影视剧，
en: From the perspective of information tolerance, academic works and papers > popular books > audio > films and TV dramas.

text: 作为被管理者，可以通过这条规律反推自己的行动策略——如果你想了解更接近真实的信息，必须探索那些晦涩难懂的区域，因为那里的污染程度较轻。
en: As a managed person, you can use this rule to infer your own action strategy — if you want to understand information closer to the truth, you must explore those obscure and difficult areas, because the pollution there is lighter.

text: 4、为这句话单列一条——“使你不快的观点，往往是让你成长的契机”，
en: 4. Give this sentence its own item — 'Views that make you uncomfortable are often the opportunity for your growth'.

text: 所谓信息茧房，所谓回音室效应，都在说这个道理：一旦认定某种观点，就不自觉地执着于相似的理论，看得越多越坚信不疑，
en: The so-called information cocoon and echo chamber effect all speak to this truth: once you affirm a certain view, you unconsciously cling to similar theories, and the more you read, the more convinced you become.

text: 这时再看到不同观点，会不自觉地生出一种抵触情绪，膝跳反应般地用阴谋论之类的逻辑来解释，质疑对方的立场和动机，
en: When you then see different views, you unconsciously develop a resistance, reflexively using conspiracy theories and similar logic to explain them, questioning the other party's position and motives.

text: 我总以为这其中有某种心理投射效应，
en: I always think there is some kind of psychological projection effect in this.

text: 即，认知较低的家伙一旦对某种理论表示信服，就会不自觉地将自身投射到这理论上，
en: That is, once a person with lower cognition expresses belief in a certain theory, they unconsciously project themselves onto that theory.

text: 看到反对观点，就会不假思索地觉得自己受到了侮辱，觉得对方是在骂自己。
en: Seeing opposing views, they think without hesitation that they have been insulted, feeling that the other party is scolding them.

text: 其实这种现象很常见，不管是饭圈的明星，还是体育圈的球星，甚至著名历史人物，
en: Actually, this phenomenon is very common, whether it is celebrities in fan circles, stars in sports circles, or even famous historical figures.

text: 共性是——将自身投射于某种理论、某位名人，想象出一个虚幻的偶像，不允许任何人对其有一丝批评。
en: The common thread is — projecting oneself onto a certain theory or celebrity, imagining an illusory idol, and not allowing anyone the slightest criticism of it.

text: 这种行为的本质，是自身不具备主体性，于是将自己希冀的特点和能力寄托于理论or名人，将其神格化。
en: The essence of this behaviour is that one lacks subjectivity, and so pins the characteristics and abilities one hopes for onto a theory or celebrity, deifying them.

text: 本质上是没有建立自我，没有真正想做的事情，
en: Essentially, it is not having established a self, not having something one truly wants to do.

text: 面对虚无的恐惧，总想找一个救命稻草，抓住后就不允许别人有一丝批评。
en: Facing the fear of nothingness, one always wants to find a life-saving straw, and once grasped, will not allow others the slightest criticism of it.

text: 建议将这种迹象作为提醒自己的信号，一旦出现，就要问问自己，是否陷入了信息茧房，是否将观点与自身绑定？
en: It is recommended to use this sign as a reminder to yourself: once it appears, ask yourself whether you have fallen into an information cocoon, and whether you have bound your views to yourself.

text: 5、区分如下几个基本概念，“事实”（fact）、“观点”(opinion)、“立场”（position）和“理论”（theory），
en: 5. Distinguish the following basic concepts: 'fact', 'opinion', 'position' and 'theory'.

text: 这可以助你判断互联网上各种声音的可信度，
en: This can help you judge the credibility of various voices on the internet.

text: 何为“事实”？
en: What is a 'fact'?

text: 答：外界给定的材料，是人类思考之素材，在此时此刻，它不会随着你的思考结论的变化而变化。
en: Answer: material given by the outside world, the raw material of human thought; at this moment, it does not change with changes in your thinking conclusions.

text: 何为“观点”?
en: What is an 'opinion'?

text: 答：根据外界给定材料，每个人思考后（甚至不经思考后）得出的结论，它可以在下一秒就发生180度逆转。
en: Answer: conclusions drawn by each person after thinking (or even without thinking) based on material given by the outside world; they can reverse 180 degrees in the next second.

text: 何为“立场？
en: What is a “position?

text: 答：植根于每个人内心深处，最根深蒂固的“观点”，它并非不可改变，但改变的过程往往非常痛苦。
en: Answer: rooted deep in each person's heart, the most deep-rooted 'opinion'; it is not unchangeable, but the process of change is often very painful.

text: 何为“理论”？
en: What is a 'theory'?

text: 答：将诸多“事实”串联在一起形成“观点”，这一逻辑过程即为“理论”。
en: Answer: stringing together many 'facts' to form an 'opinion'; this logical process is a 'theory'.

text: 批判性思维的核心是什么？
en: What is the core of critical thinking?

text: 是评估，是一种不断逼近真相的活动，
en: It is evaluation, an activity of constantly approaching the truth.

text: 对别人吐出的每一句话，你需要问自己，这里面哪些是“事实”，哪些是对方的“观点”，是否预设了某种“立场”，是否串联成某种“理论”，
en: For every sentence others utter, you need to ask yourself: which parts are 'facts', which are the other party's 'opinions', whether some 'position' is presupposed, and whether they are strung together into some 'theory'.

text: 若你发现某些博主，永远只强调“观点”和“立场”，毫无“事实”的成分，看第一条建议，不要让TA出现在自己的信息流里。
en: If you find that certain bloggers always emphasise only 'opinions' and 'positions', with no 'fact' component at all, see the first suggestion: do not let them appear in your information flow.

text: 6、建立交叉验证的意识，兼听则明，
en: 6. Establish awareness of cross-validation: listening to both sides makes you wise.

text: 比如你想了解某个历史事件，假使有3个利益相关方ABC，你只有3个小时，
en: For example, if you want to understand a historical event, suppose there are 3 stakeholders A, B and C, and you have only 3 hours.

text: 那最佳策略是——找到3份分别由A、B、C关于这一事件出具的资料，将他们所说的事实互相映证，将他们的观点互相对比，
en: Then the best strategy is — find 3 documents issued by A, B and C respectively about this event, verify the facts they state against each other, and compare their views with each other.

text: 而不是把所有时间都用来看A这边的人出具的资料。
en: Rather than spending all your time reading documents issued by people on A's side.

text: 换言之，有意识地让自己站在不同立场上看待同一个问题，才可能逼近事情的全貌。
en: In other words, consciously standing on different positions to view the same problem is what may bring you closer to the full picture.
